historical_cutoff: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 10 (2026-11-16); no Week 11 games included

eligibility_basis.rule: QB named starter; primary and secondary RBs; top three WRs on current depth chart; top expected TE.
eligibility_basis.notes: Rachaad White is questionable but retained as a primary back. Injury status does not remove a player from quantitative eligibility.

qualification_rule: Market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one fixed ladder threshold >= 8/10. L10 uses the 10 most recent qualifying regular-season games before cutoff across seasons; no zero-padding for missed games.
percentile_method: 20 most recent qualifying regular-season games before cutoff; standard linear interpolation at (20-1)*0.15 = 2.85.
main_line_selection_method: FanDuel primary; DraftKings only if no FanDuel market rows for that player/market. Among available over lines, select odds numerically closest to -110; tie resolves to lower threshold.
